changelog: Security: rescue.php, upgrade.php and the forced reinstall link now require the full SECRET_KEY; the first 16 characters are no longer accepted
Fixed permanent ticket deletion, which failed with "Ticket could not be deleted safely" on self-hosted installations
Agent API: agent-docs works with every API token again and lists only the scopes a token is actually missing
Agent API: new agent-delete-comment action deletes a comment the token owner may manage
Agent API: writes sent with an Idempotency-Key share one database transaction, so retries replay the stored result without duplicate records
Agent API: applied work logs return a direct ticket link, and older ticket links with hash= open correctly, including completed tickets
Ticket list actions recover automatically when the page's security token has expired, for example after signing in again in another tab
Incoming email: messages from active users are accepted without adding their address to Allowed Senders
Incoming email: formatted messages keep images, lists, tables and emphasis in tickets and comments; tables and remote images now display correctly
